Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to the most common questions about how these 3v3 DPS rankings are created and how to interpret the current meta.

Which DPS class is best for 3v3s in WoW?

The best 3v3 DPS specialization can change as the season progresses, but currently Subtlety Rogue leads the rankings. These rankings are based on live data from top-rated players, ensuring they accurately reflect the current WoW DPS meta.

How are the DPS rankings determined?

Murlok gathers data from active 3v3 players across US, EU, KR, and TW regions. Characters are filtered to ensure they remain active and consistently tied to a single specialization, following the same criteria as our class guides.

How often is the DPS meta updated?

Murlok 3v3 DPS rankings refresh every 8 hours, keeping the page aligned with the latest trends in high-level PvP.
